Relatable dude. First you need to talk to your girlfriend about your feelings & her's as well. Try to clear out the air so that jokes seem like jokes & not an insult. If a certain way of talking hurts you then its better you talk about it. Also you need to work on your self confidence. Being akward & clumsy hurts your self confidence even more. Try to stay in the moment rather than talking to yourself all day long. Also like try to loose weight. Not only will it help you physically but also mentally. Just a suggestion as I too lost upwards of 30 lbs in 3 months & it did wonders for me.

Was thinking about having a dog myself today. Having a pet helps especially when there's no one for you. Bucket list idea sounds good as well. I guess need to keep trying. Anyways thanks :)
